records.company_description: Revolve Surgical is advancing a next-generation surgical robotics platform designed to make robotic assistance more accessible across operating rooms, from outpatient centres to academic hospitals. Their bedside, zero-footprint system preserves direct surgeon control while integrating AI-driven assistance to support precision, reduce barriers to adoption, and expand access to advanced surgical care. Through the HealthSpark collaboration , Vector Institute and Revolve Surgical will work together to advance foundational AI capabilities for real-time assistance and optimizing workflows during surgical tasks.

records.company_description: Banting AI is a clinical trial intelligence platform for academic medical centers, cancer centers, and research networks. The platform structures every trial protocol once into a reusable data layer, “parse once, generate many”, which then powers downstream workflows including feasibility, ethics review, budgeting, and document drafting. The result is faster trial activation and meaningfully less administrative burden. The HealthSpark collaboration will advance Banting AI’s protocol-aware automation across additional clinical trial workflows, with a focus on accuracy, compliance, and driving efficiency for research teams.

records.company_description: MedEssist helps local pharmacies operate as technology-enabled care sites, supporting clinical assessments, diagnostics, and prescription treatments through collaboration between pharmacists, nurses, and physicians. Their platform is used in over 750 pharmacies across Canada and the US to streamline workflows and expand access for a wide range of medical treatments. MedEssist’s HealthSpark project will focus on automations: both within the platform and between external systems even when application programming interfaces (APIs) are unavailable or have limited functionality. The project will use AI agents that combine computer vision, robotic process automation, and large language models (LLMs) to automate tasks such as documentation, data entry, billing, prescription refills, and data gathering from external sources

records.company_description: IDENTOS partnered with Vector Institute’s HealthSpark program to develop an AI-powered navigation tool that connects patients with community services using natural language. In four months, IDENTOS deployed its client-ready AI solution, created and preserved five new jobs, trained more staff in AI, and developed new intellectual property in Ontario.

records.company_description: Verto Health ‘s patented AI technology delivers Digital Twin journeys for Population Health, powering 11.5M+ patient visits across 100+ sites and 25+ health systems. Verto transforms data from any source into near real-time patient journeys to improve care and reduce administrative burden for providers. The HealthSpark initiative will accelerate Verto’s development of an AI-driven model that unlocks a new era of personalized care and better population health management for Canadians.

records.company_description: MedMe Health is Canada’s leading pharmacy clinical services platform, trusted by 4,500+ pharmacies, including 70% of enterprise chains. MedMe equips pharmacies to launch, manage, and grow their clinical services through a SaaS platform that transforms them into community health hubs. MedMe’s AI Clinical Assistant, the first and only pharmacy-specific scribe, automatically fills clinical documentation, marking the company’s first step toward an AI-powered workflow solution tailored to pharmacists. The company aims to tap into Vector’s expertise to build complementary AI-driven patient concierge capabilities.

records.company_description: Tenomix Inc . is reshaping the future of pathology to enable physicians and the Canadian health system to deliver better and more timely cancer care. Its novel technologies harness robotics, imaging and AI to streamline pathology workflows and enhance precision, enabling faster, more efficient, and cost-effective diagnosis and subsequent treatment. The company is working with the HealthSpark team to advance AI innovation that will help power the next generation of precision cancer diagnostics.
